family_reports.body: I remember the screams from my kids on the phone when I told my husband that we needed to get the kids ready to go to their dad's house. For six years I have battled, for a year I haven't seen them, for five months now...my daughter has refused to talk to me.

The family court system has made me lose all faith and belief in justice. What should be a safe harbor for abused women, who finally have mustered the strength to leave and speak up, is instead protecting the abuser and causing additional harm to mothers and children. To walk into a family court case with decent credit (high 600s) and still be stuck in it two years later with no end in sight, financially destitute with a score now in the 400s, and facing bankruptcy because there has been no accountability for my ex not following orders and leaving me 100% financially responsible for all expenses, after being a stay-at-home mom for the 15 years of our marriage, is unfathomable. Our children do not have basic toiletries, are wearing uniforms to school with holes and stains, can only have one pair of shoes for the entire school year, and have had to miss out on driving school, orthodontic treatment, dental cleanings, sports, music lessons, standardized test prep, necessary tutors, and school lunches. To no fault of their own, they went from living in gated communities, vacationing regularly in Florida, playing multiple club sports, taking music lessons, and never worrying about being able to get new clothes, shoes, and food to eat....to getting christmas presents from the Angel Tee charity, wearing clothes with stains and holes, living in an apartment community, missing out on sports and music lessons, not being able to take any vacations, and having to prepare rice and potatoes for our dog to eat because we couldn't afford dog food...all while there is documentation online of my ex working and making lots of money, but lying to the courts saying he is disabled and that he cannot work and cannot pay for anything. They ignore my evidence and allow the charade to continue. Our children have been suffering because of it...but no one wants to hear about them. Opposing counsel actually said to me, "we already settled child custody, so I don't want to hear about your children suffering because it's irrelevant." This system is not an advocate for children. This system is in place solely for the money and who can support who for upcoming campaigns...or who has relationships behind the scenes that we know nothing about. I firmly believe that. How do you have children suffering because a mother who has had to go back to her career in an entry-level position, after 15 years of sacrificing hers to allow her husband to grow in his as an executive and successful business consultant, makes only entry-level/modest pay, but was left with a stack of bills based off of $600,000+ income and is receiving no child support, no alimony, and $0 help with any expenses, and the court does nothing to help? They only continue to support the man who has a stack of evidence including online reviews, photos, PI reports showing he has committed perjury and is lying to the court about not being able to work. It's sickening. We have lost two years of our lives to this system. Life continues on and my children have had to sacrifice and miss out on so much, but the court acts like it doesn't affect them...and doesn't want to hear about how it is hurting them. They want to support a man who claims medical disability but who shows not one piece of objective evidence to support that claim. If it weren't for family and friends, we would be homeless currently, and I honestly feel that opposing counsel purposefully created that situation in the hopes that her client could then take custody. I do not trust anyone in this system. It is completely corrupt and I am heartbroken and sick over what me and my children have experienced.

This family court system has shown my son everything I have raised him not to be but because of this corruption throughout our country it’s the most devastating money racket that teaches children how to lie, cheat and steal and use the courts to get away with the crimes.
It has taken everything from me, torn my family apart at a cost/debt that will be paid ultimately by my children. Everyone close to me has been affectedband are at a lose.

public_comments.comment_text: Coreen Khoury participates in ex parte communication. She will use your kids as leverage ( place them in foster care) to make you comply. She has no understanding or knowledge of domestic violence and therefore should never be allowed to make rulings in such cases. This places children's lives and well being in very serious danger. During the divorce from my ex who was highly abusive she threatened to put my child in foster care if I didn't alter my sworn testimony so it wasn't so damning to my ex. She also separated my two daughters. Gave custody of my oldest to her father because of the domestic violence at my house that was perpetrated by my ex who I hadn't been with in over a year. She allowed me to have joint custody of the youngest daughter that I share with my abuser.After court my ex kidnapped my daughter it took two years to get a court date that she continued and then dismissed after I told her I had not seen my child in 2 years. She gave advice to my ex on how to obtain custody during a child support collection hearing. I wasn't present for . . Signed papers saying I abondaned my child . Signed search warrants for DSS with no real complaint. Has never made my ex pay a dime in child support. Actually suspended his obligation in exparte communication. . After I locate my daughter 4 + years later this judge gives my ex temporary primary custody. He hasn't allowed me a single visit. My daughter finally run away from his home and discloses the abuse with audio evidence she has endured for years so the judge puts her in foster care where she has been since the discoosure . Currently in a group home and they are still allowing visits from her father not to mention I was forced to proceed unrepresented each hearing.

public_comments.comment_text: Since my ex got a new attorney over a year ago, every time this judge hears our case, no matter how much it is obvious that my ex has not followed orders and is in the wrong, this judge sides with him and his attorney. She has refused for me to have my rule to show cause motion heard for over a year, despite clear evidence that my ex has committed perjury in court and is refusing to follow over ten orders, leaving me and our children in financial ruin with $0 in support from him. She has refused to order child support or alimony in my case. She has continued trial with no documentation that supports the need to do so. She has refused to hear multiple motions of mine asking for reconsideration of temporary orders.
